title: Cheap, cloudy plastic
text: Cheap, cloudy plastic. They’re fine I guess if you’re just looking for something basic. It’s my fault because I was expecting glass clarity and that’s definitely not found here. If you want higher quality I’d pay a few more bucks and stick with glass.
